title: Canvas Viewport
subtitle: Dev-server canvas — every viewport state from v1.0 → v1.3 (Phase 3.5 → Phase 12) · 10 artboards · classic desktop menubar (File · Edit · View · Selection · Tools · Help) per shadcn radix
brief: Multi-artboard meta-design of the md-claude dev-server canvas (this very tool) — every distinct canvas-viewport state that v1.0 → v1.3 will ship, broken down by screen. Synthesized from .ai/plans/phase-{4,5,6,8,12}.md. Scope: features that touch the canvas viewport itself (infinite canvas + pan/zoom + mini-map, draw tools, pin-comments, presentation mode, live collab, inspector + layers). Explicitly NOT in scope: app shell chrome (left file-tree, top header, tabs row, status bar, system view, comments-list panel) — those live in a separate canvas covering Phase 3.5.

artboards.label: CV-01 · IDLE INFINITE CANVAS
artboards.notes: fit-to-screen view, 6 artboards free-form, mini-map bottom-right, zoom toolbar, brand mark wordmark ≥ 40px

artboards.label: CV-02 · ZOOMED-IN VIEWPORT
artboards.notes: 1.0× zoom on single artboard, selection halo, red viewport rectangle in mini-map

artboards.label: CV-03 · DRAW MODE · PEN
artboards.notes: hand-drawn red annotations IS the signature moment; pen tool + color picker visible

artboards.label: CV-04 · PIN-COMMENT THREAD
artboards.notes: floating thread panel with own 6px hard-shadow + @-mention dropdown (3 git committers)

artboards.label: CV-05 · PRESENTATION MODE
artboards.notes: full-bleed artboard, all chrome dropped except floating 3/6 counter — restraint as the moment

artboards.label: CV-06 · LIVE COLLAB SESSION
artboards.notes: yellow soft-lock banner spanning full width — boldest typographic moment; 2 remote cursors + participant avatars

artboards.label: CV-07 · INSPECTOR + LAYERS
artboards.notes: 3-column Webflow-grade density; layers tree + inspector panel + source-rewrite strategy chip

artboards.label: CV-08 · PROJECT + DS TREE
artboards.notes: Two-pane: left file tree (search + PROJECT/DS/UI/RUNTIME sections, disclosure glyphs, modified dot, unread badge) + right selected-file detail (metadata + accent-stamp + artboard index)

artboards.label: CV-09 · DESIGN SYSTEM VIEW
artboards.notes: Token surfaces ladder + 8-step type ladder rendered at actual size + 8 specimen thumbnails — the 'how the DS looks in the viewer' surface

artboards.label: CV-10 · COMMENTS SIDEBAR
artboards.notes: Two-pane: left canvas-context (faux Onboarding mock w/ M pin on Continue) + right 380px sidebar (Comments header, 3 tabs ALL 15 / OPEN 8 active / RESOLVED 7, expanded thread item + 5 collapsed items + 1 resolved muted). Sidebar layout matches Figma/Linear comments-panel convention.
